description: This file defines the Retireable interface in the OpenMRS project, which specifies methods for managing retired or voided data objects, including retired status, retired by user, date retired, and retire reason.

classes.name: Retireable
classes.description: An interface representing entities within OpenMRS that can be retired, providing methods to check and set retired status, retired by user, date retired, and retire reason.

methods.name: isRetired
methods.description: Returns whether the object is retired; deprecated in favor of getRetired()

methods.name: getRetired
methods.description: Retrieves the retired status of the object

methods.name: setRetired
methods.description: Sets the retired status of the object

methods.name: getRetiredBy
methods.description: Returns the user who retired the object

methods.name: setRetiredBy
methods.description: Sets the user who retired the object

methods.name: getDateRetired
methods.description: Returns the date when the object was retired

methods.name: setDateRetired
methods.description: Sets the date when the object was retired

methods.name: getRetireReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for retiring the object

methods.name: setRetireReason
methods.description: Sets the reason for retiring the object
